prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original tileable ground albedo texture for a polished 3D strategy game called Chicken Civ, to be wrapped onto real terrain, NOT a scene illustration. Create a square 2048x2048 seamless texture of short dense wild meadow grass seen perfectly top down orthographically, representing a 2 meter by 2 meter area. Fine interwoven slender blades and tiny curled dry straw, subtle small bare-soil gaps, organically varied olive and moss greens with muted warm yellow-green tips. Lush natural tactile surface, artful painterly realism suitable for high quality stylized game terrain. Flat diffuse even illumination, no directional shadows, no highlights baked across the image, no perspective, no horizon, no vignette. Uniform overall density and luminance, subtle tiny variation, no large bright clumps or large mottled patches. Edges must tile naturally on all four sides. No flowers, trees, tall grass, rocks, objects, characters, text, watermark, border or panels. This is ONLY one clean continuous grass material texture.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original tileable rock albedo texture for a polished 3D strategy game called Chicken Civ, to be wrapped onto real rock terrain, NOT a scene illustration. Create a square 2048x2048 seamless texture of exposed weathered sedimentary stone seen perfectly front on orthographically, representing a 3 meter by 3 meter rock face. Dense fine mineral grain, angular broken weathered faces, sparse narrow irregular dark fissures, subtle layered strata with varied orientation, occasional fine ochre mineral seams, almost no moss. Cool neutral gray with restrained warm taupe undertones; strong readable medium-scale natural rock detail and finer mineral detail. Artful painterly realism suitable for high quality stylized game terrain. Surface is continuous rock, not separate cobbles: no polygon-cell network, no paving, no bricks, no tiling grid. Flat diffuse even illumination, no directional shadows, no dramatic highlights, no perspective, no horizon, no vignette. Uniform average luminance across image; no giant features. Edges tile naturally on all four sides. No trees, plants, grass, water, objects, characters, text, watermark, border or panels. This is ONLY one clean continuous weathered stone material texture.
